source: That model is the foundation for the next handbooks. AS03 will quantify arithmetic intensity. AS04 will place workloads against compute and bandwidth ceilings. AS07–AS09 will zoom into coalescing, shared memory, registers, and occupancy. AS11 will explain why fusion can remove whole trips through the hierarchy.
zh: 该模型是下一本手册的基础。 AS03将量化算术强度。 AS04 将根据计算和带宽上限来安排工作负载。 AS07-AS09 将重点讨论合并、共享内存、寄存器和占用。 AS11 将解释为什么融合可以删除整个层次结构的行程。
